name: The Essential Shirt – Black
description:
A timeless black shirt designed for effortless style. Featuring a clean button-down silhouette and a sleek finish, The Essential Black Shirt brings a refined edge to your everyday wardrobe.

THE ESSENTIAL BLACK SHIRT
Timeless. Minimal. Effortless.
The Essential Black Shirt is designed for those who believe less is more. Its classic black tone and clean button-down silhouette create a refined look that works effortlessly from casual days to elevated evenings.
Designed with a sleek, versatile aesthetic, it pairs seamlessly with trousers, denim, or your favorite everyday essentials.
